events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with the US and Iran engaging in military conflicts. The situation is volatile, and the market is expected to react strongly. The US has shown its military strength, but its geopolitical power is waning.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will lead to increased volatility in the market. Gold is expected to rise as a safe-haven asset, while emerging markets will likely suffer due to the geopolitical uncertainty.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the situation closely and adjust the position as needed

events.exitStrategy: Close the position if the Iran war de-escalates or if the market becomes less volatile

gains.conservativeNote: If the war does not spread to other countries
gains.extendedNote: If the war spreads to other countries
